artifacts.summary: Four-route verdict, regression-guard citation, and gate evidence for Check 1 namespace resolution.

completion_data.completion_summary: Check 1 of scripts/typst-sync-check.sh now resolves fully-qualified Lean declaration names against a build-free, comment-aware namespace index instead of a literal grep; the gate exits 0 on all four checks and the restored citation at typst/FormalFoundations.typ:807 is the live regression guard. Limits are documented in the script, the whitelist header and typst/SYNC-MAP.md; no whitelist entry was added. The summary records the verdict: option (a) taken, options (b), (c) and the docstring route rejected.

memory_candidates.content: A text-only gate that validates cited identifiers by literal grep passes or fails by coincidence of source text (a docstring mentioning the dotted name). To prove a structural resolver is load-bearing, keep one live citation whose dotted form has zero literal hits and no whitelist entry (durable positive control), and once run a length-preserving swap of the coincidental docstring mention (negative control, reverted).
